title: Rare happenings in the deep
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.name: Red Veil
items.desc: The dim lights flicker red, shadows pulse, and the air hums with a sinister energy.

items.name: Qi Flood
items.desc: The halls seem to pulse with a faint glow, and the air feels thick with an otherworldly energy, making your own qi stir restlessly within you.

items.name: Venerable Guide
items.desc: Arriving on the floor, you see an old cultivator sitting under a flickering oil lamp, surrounded by a small circle of apprentices. The air hums with the faint scent of aged parchment and the sound of whispered knowledge.

items.name: Starfall Glitter
items.desc: The ground glows with a strange, radiant blue light, casting eerie shadows as you step closer to the source of the luminescence, a piece of fallen star iron.

items.name: Golden Hare
items.desc: A small, gilded hare scampers across the floor, dropping coins in its path like seed pods; the moment feels weighted with ancient magic, as if the very air whispers with lost secrets.

items.name: Sky's Whisper
items.desc: The air feels thin and cold, and for a moment, the stars cut through the stone, their light like a promise from another world; the blood of your ancestors burns in your veins, calling you forward.
